description: RC2.2: the radiance cache first image through the three adapter (screenInputs, the composite with its shading module by screenUV) beside DDGI, on cornell-box, two-room and sponza at 1280x720, single bounce (useMultibounce off, like for like with the one-bounce reference; since RC6.1 not with one-bounce DDGI, whose hits get no sky light where the cache's do, which moves Sponza's giLuminanceRatio): no negative or NaN values in the picture or the irradiance, the screen stage once per picture; then, as information only, the multibounce on against the same references; a contact sheet for the screenshot.
